result.instructions: Tools for Smoove, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many contacts unsubscribed this month, and what reasons did they give?"; "Add this new subscriber to our newsletter list and set their first name."; "Show the open and click rates for our last email campaign.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Smoove data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run smoove_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run smoove_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run smoove_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. smoove_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: smoove_get_contact_fields
tools.title: Get contact fields
tools.description: List the contact field definitions of the account, system and custom, with their keys and types. Call this first to learn the field keys (e.g. firstName, i1) that other tools accept. Smoove API: GET /v1/Account/ContactFields.

tools.name: smoove_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List active (not deleted) contacts with the chosen fields, paged and sorted. Use smoove_get_contact for one contact. Smoove API: GET /v1/Contacts.

fields.description: Comma-separated contact fields to return, e.g. id,email,firstName.

sort.description: Sort fields; prefix with '-' for descending, e.g. -id.

includeCustomFields.description: Include custom field values in the result.

tools.name: smoove_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Get one contact by its id, email, cell phone or external id. Smoove API: GET /v1/Contacts/{id}.

id.description: The contact identifier, matching the 'by' value.

by.description: How the id is matched: ContactId (default), Email, CellPhone or ExternalId.

fields.description: Comma-separated contact fields to return, e.g. id,email,firstName.

includeCustomFields.description: Include custom field values in the result.

tools.name: smoove_contact_exists
tools.title: Check contact exists
tools.description: Check whether a contact exists in the account. Returns true or false. Smoove API: GET /v1/Contacts/{id}/Exists.

id.description: The contact identifier, matching the 'by' value.

by.description: How the id is matched: ContactId, Email, CellPhone or ExternalId. Required.

tools.name: smoove_list_unsubscribed_contacts
tools.title: List unsubscribed contacts
tools.description: List contacts who unsubscribed, with the unsubscribe time and reason. Use it to check opt-outs before a send. Smoove API: GET /v1/Contacts_Unsubscribers.

fields.description: Comma-separated contact fields to return, e.g. id,email,firstName.

sort.description: Sort fields; prefix with '-' for descending, e.g. -id.

includeCustomFields.description: Include custom field values in the result.

tools.name: smoove_list_lists
tools.title: List lists
tools.description: List the contact lists of the account, with names and optional contact counts. Smoove API: GET /v1/Lists.

sort.description: Sort fields; prefix with '-' for descending, e.g. -id.

includeContactsCount.description: Include the number of contacts in each list.

tools.name: smoove_list_contacts_in_list
tools.title: List contacts in a list
tools.description: List the contacts that belong to one list, with the chosen fields. Smoove API: GET /v1/Lists/{id}/Contacts.

fields.description: Comma-separated contact fields to return, e.g. id,email,firstName.

sort.description: Sort fields; prefix with '-' for descending, e.g. -id.

includeCustomFields.description: Include custom field values in the result.

tools.name: smoove_list_campaign_templates
tools.title: List campaign templates
tools.description: List the custom email campaign templates of the account. Smoove API: GET /v1/Campaigns_Templates.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields: id, name, imageUrl, timeStamp.

tools.name: smoove_get_campaign_statistics
tools.title: Get campaign statistics
tools.description: Get the aggregated report of one email campaign: sent, bounced, opened, clicked and unsubscribed counts. Smoove API: GET /v1/Campaigns/{id}/Statistics.

id.description: The campaign id, or its external id when by is ExternalId.

tools.name: smoove_list_landing_pages
tools.title: List landing pages
tools.description: List the active landing pages and sign-up forms of the account. Smoove API: GET /v1/LandingPages.

tools.name: smoove_upsert_contact
tools.title: Create or update contact
tools.description: Create a contact, or update it when one matches the email, externalId or cellPhone. Only set canReceiveEmails to true when the person opted in. Smoove API: POST /v1/Contacts?updateIfExists=true.

externalId.description: Your own id for the contact.

canReceiveEmails.description: Set true only when the contact opted in to email.

lists_ToSubscribe.description: List ids to add the contact to.

lists_ToUnsubscribe.description: List ids to remove the contact from.

customFields.description: Custom field values keyed by field key (see smoove_get_contact_fields).

tools.name: smoove_unsubscribe_contact
tools.title: Unsubscribe contact
tools.description: Unsubscribe a contact from email and campaigns, with an optional reason. The contact stops receiving messages. Smoove API: POST /v1/Contacts/{id}/Unsubscribe.

id.description: The contact identifier, matching the 'by' value.

by.description: How the id is matched: ContactId, Email, CellPhone or ExternalId. Required.

reason.description: Free-text reason, stored with the unsubscribe.

tools.name: smoove_create_list
tools.title: Create list
tools.description: Create a new contact list in the account. Smoove API: POST /v1/Lists.

publicName.description: Name shown to subscribers on sign-up pages.

isPublic.description: Whether sign-up pages can show the list.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Smoove
prompts.description: What you can do with Smoove here, with example requests to try.
